parsed.explanation: Strong traveller-facing picture: no trans-specific criminal offence, legal gender recognition since 2007, a comprehensive anti-discrimination law (2022, no small-business/religious exemptions) and a same-sex marriage vote described as 'extremely positive' — documented social acceptance plus protections shown in force, not merely paper. Rule of law is a mitigator here because institutions are recorded working FOR equality. Deductions are modest: retained male homosexual 'not in private' offences are a dead-letter tangential signal with no evidence of use against gender-nonconforming people; prison placement and border/entry treatment are unresolved open questions (light, not exposures); no documented visitor-service enforcement cases or bias-assault prosecutions. Absence of violence/border records in an otherwise well-documented, tolerant jurisdiction reads moderately positive. No universal-exposure measure or organised targeting appears anywhere in the record.
